assumptions: Genotypes are called correctly and samples are unrelated for F and HWE to mean what they say.
The population given is the one the statistics should describe.
limits: Missing calls are reported rather than imputed.
HWE departure has many causes (structure, selection, genotyping error) and the test names none of them.
bio.jane/contract.question: What are this call set's per-site and per-sample genotype statistics, including heterozygosity, F and the exact Hardy-Weinberg test?

description: Per-site and per-sample genotype statistics of a call set, for all samples or one population: allele counts and frequencies, called and missing calls, heterozygous and homozygous counts, observed and expected heterozygosity and the inbreeding coefficient F (scikit-allel), and the exact Hardy–Weinberg test with its excess-heterozygosity tail (bcftools +fill-tags). Validated on every site and sample of 1000 Genomes phase 3 APOL1 in 32 groups.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

group.description: compute over this group's samples only; empty is every sample.

groupBy.description: which column of the sample table groups the samples; empty is its first grouping column.

populations.description: a sample table: a header row with a `sample` column and one or more grouping columns (tab-separated, as 1000 Genomes' .panel). Samples it does not list belong to no group.

vcf.description: the call set as VCF text (a .vcf, or a .vcf.gz already decompressed); every record's GT is read, ploidy 2.

name: population_site_stats

samples.description: one row per sample: its group, called, missing, het, homAlt and the missing and het rates

sites.description: one row per record: chrom, pos, ref, alts, allele counts and frequencies, AN, called, missing, het, homRef, homAlt, ho, he, f, hwe and excHet per ALT

summary.description: sites, samples, segregating, biallelic and multiallelic sites, mean Ho and He, and the sites with the smallest HWE p-values
